known_issue.description: Ty's Vision answers one yes/no question about an image. It reads meaning, not characters: fine code text is lost and unreadable details are confabulated. It must never be a code source or a code reader.
known_issue.resolution: Code reading stays with the coding lane, which reads source TEXT via agent_kernel.coding_tools.Workspace. Ty's Vision stays a verdict oracle for renders and screenshots (graduation Stage 2). A screenshot may be OCR'd to text for a human or a coder, but the vision model is never the source of that text.
known_issue.rule: Never feed vision-model output into a code edit. If a screenshot must inform a change, OCR it, treat the OCR text as untrusted data, and re-read the real file from disk before editing.

vision_code_probe_20261105.boundaries: Local lane only. No Amazon request, no spend, no cloud inference, no credential read, no policy or allowlist change. GPU left idle (13 MiB used) and the worker stopped after the test.
